      <h2>A bit about me</h2>
      <div class="about-mini">
        <div class="headshot"><div class="frame" tabindex="0"><img src="assets/img/headshot-small.jpg" alt="Duc (Bill) Le" width="240" height="300"></div><div class="dim dim-h">Fig. 1</div></div>
        <p>My name is Duc Le, and most people call me Bill. Most of my work is the part nobody sees: finding shops that can machine a part to print, keeping orders in step with drawing changes, and checking that what arrives is what we asked for. I like that the job sits between engineering, finance, and the supplier, and that a late part means a late tool.</p>

        <li data-stop="fl"><span class="yr">2018 to 2020</span><h3>Windermere Preparatory School, Florida</h3><p>Two years of high school in Florida.</p></li>
        <li data-stop="or"><span class="yr">2023</span><h3>State of Oregon, Department of Administrative Services</h3><p>Procurement and contract assistant. Public purchasing under state rules, and my first look at spend data across hundreds of vendors.</p></li>
        <li data-stop="or"><span class="yr">2023 to 2024</span><h3>Oregon State University</h3><p>Financial services assistant. Built a SharePoint onboarding hub and moved a paper approval process into Power Automate. On the side, forecast demand for a local restaurant as a class project.</p></li>
        <li data-stop="or"><span class="yr">2024</span><h3>BS, Supply Chain and Logistics Management</h3><p>Graduated from Oregon State. ASCM certificates in procurement (2023) and planning (2024).</p></li>
        <li data-stop="tx"><span class="yr">2024 to 2025</span><h3>Oliden Technology, Stafford, TX</h3><p>Procurement for MWD/LWD components. Built a PO tracking system, cleared an old backlog in SAP, and set up the approved supplier process to ISO and API standards.</p></li>
        <li data-stop="tx"><span class="yr">2026</span><h3>Back at Oliden for a summer build</h3><p>Sourced parts for a rotary steerable and MWD/LWD build with a fixed assembly date, and worked quality issues with machine shops.</p></li>
        <li class="now" data-stop="tx"><span class="yr">2025 to now</span><h3>University of Houston, Bauer College of Business</h3><p>MS in Supply Chain Management, finishing May 2027. Instructional assistant for SCM 4330 since October 2025, and vice president of the Supply Chain Club.</p></li>
        <li><span class="yr">Next</span><h3>What's next</h3><p>Downhole procurement at an oilfield services company.</p></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>
